Statimque præcepit servis suis Raguel ut replerent fossam quam fecerant priusquam elucesceret.
And immediately Raguel instructed his servants to refill the pit, which they had made, before daylight.
Uxori autem suæ dixit ut instrueret convivium,
And then he told his wife to make ready a feast,
et præpararet omnia quæ in cibos erant iter agentibus necessaria.
and to prepare all the provisions that are necessary for those who undertake a journey.
and four rams to be killed,
et parari epulas omnibus vicinis suis,
and a banquet to be prepared for all his neighbors
and every one of his friends.
Et adjuravit Raguel Tobiam ut duas hebdomadas moraretur apud se.
And Raguel pleaded with Tobias to delay with him for two weeks.
De omnibus autem quæ possidebat Raguel,
Moreover, of all the things that Raguel possessed,
he gave one half part to Tobias,
ut pars dimidia quæ supererat, post obitum eorum Tobiæ dominio deveniret.
so that the half that remained should also pass into the ownership of Tobias, after their deaths.
